guide_enrichment.narrative:
We are not treating Purdue's 44-19 opener against Indiana State as proof that its offense has taken a major step forward. The more useful takeaway for us is that returning quarterback Ryan Browne completed 23 of 29 passes for 317 yards and three touchdowns. That continuity matters, although we remain mindful that all five offensive linemen made their first Purdue starts in the opener.

Our numbers also show potential openings for both offenses. Purdue's rushing attack faces a vulnerable UCLA run defense, but UCLA has the clearer opportunity to stress Purdue on the ground and consistently create scoring chances. That makes it difficult for us to turn a modest disagreement with the market into a position. We can see a path for Purdue to remain competitive, but the available price does not give us enough value to move beyond a pass.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch:
We will be watching Purdue's rushing offense against UCLA's run defense. Fame Ijeboi produced 87 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in his Purdue debut, giving the rebuilt offense an encouraging first result. The question for us is whether that production carries over behind a line with five new starters against a defense our numbers believe can be challenged on the ground.

If Purdue can run efficiently, we think it can reduce the burden on Browne and make it harder for UCLA to create separation. If that ground game stalls, Purdue becomes more dependent on its passing attack while UCLA owns the more favorable offensive matchups.

recent_game.fact: Purdue opened the 2026 season with a 44-19 home victory over Indiana State.
Purdue produced 523 yards of total offense against Indiana State, its first 500-yard game since Oct. 12, 2024 at Illinois.
Ryan Browne completed 23 of 29 passes for 317 yards and three touchdowns against Indiana State.
Minnesota transfer Fame Ijeboi led Purdue with 87 rushing yards and one touchdown on 11 carries and added two receptions for 30 yards in his Purdue debut.
FAU transfer Asaad Waseem caught six passes for 107 yards and one touchdown in his Purdue debut.
Don Saunders returned an interception 35 yards for a touchdown against Indiana State, Purdue's first pick-six since 2022.

opponent_notes.fact: Purdue is scheduled to play UCLA at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena on Sept. 19, 2026, with an 11 p.m. ET kickoff on BTN.
The UCLA game will be Purdue's first game at the Rose Bowl since the Boilermakers lost 34-24 to Washington in the Rose Bowl Game on Jan. 1, 2001.
The scheduled 11 p.m. ET kickoff against UCLA will be Purdue's latest start since an 11:05 p.m. ET kickoff at Hawaii on Nov. 25, 2006.

quarterback.fact: Ryan Browne is Purdue's returning starting quarterback and started all 12 games in 2025, throwing for 2,153 yards and nine touchdowns.
Browne's 317-yard performance against Indiana State was his fourth career 300-yard passing game.
Through the 2026 opener, Browne had completed 79.3 percent of his passes with three touchdowns and no interceptions.
Browne had made 15 career starts for Purdue through the 2026 opener.
Evans Chuba and Bennett Meredith competed during the spring and summer for Purdue's backup quarterback role.

offensive_personnel.fact: Purdue had five offensive linemen make their first Boilermaker starts against Indiana State: Boaz Stanley, Micah Banuelos, Brock Brownfield, Nuku Mafi and Jude McCoskey.
Brock Brownfield became the first Purdue true freshman offensive lineman to start a season opener since freshmen became eligible in 1972.
Purdue added five offensive-line transfers, including Boaz Stanley, who entered with 21 career starts; Nuku Mafi, who entered with 12; and Micah Banuelos, who entered with five.
Joey Tanona was the only returning Purdue offensive lineman who started all 12 games in 2025; Ethan Trent made six starts and Jude McCoskey played in 11 games.
The running back room changed after Devin Mockobee's graduation, with Antonio Harris the only returning running back from 2025.
Purdue added running backs Fame Ijeboi from Minnesota, Travis Terrell Jr. from Jackson State and Jerrick Gibson from Texas.
Wide receivers Xavier Townsend and Asaad Waseem joined Purdue from Iowa State and FAU, respectively.
Thirty-eight players made their Purdue debuts and 16 players made their first Boilermaker starts in the season opener.

defensive_personnel.fact: Linebacker Charles Correa returned after starting all 12 games in 2025 and recording 96 tackles, 7.5 tackles for loss and three sacks.
Purdue added defensive linemen Rodney Lora, Curt Neal and Wisdom Simms, who brought a combined 81 games of college experience.
Transfer linebacker Jojo Hayden started in his Purdue debut and recorded four tackles and one tackle for loss against Indiana State.
FIU transfer Mister Clark recorded five solo tackles, two tackles for loss, one sack and one pass breakup in his Purdue debut.
New defensive backs Jaden Mangham, Don Saunders and John Slaughter made their first Purdue starts in the season opener.

coaching_changes.fact: Kevin Kane returned to Purdue as defensive coordinator and linebackers coach after working as a Minnesota defensive analyst in 2025; he previously coordinated Purdue's defense in 2023 and 2024.
Zach Crabtree became Purdue's offensive line coach after spending the 2025 season at Fresno State.
Cornell Ford moved from coaching Purdue's wide receivers in 2025 to coaching the running backs in 2026.
Bilal Marshall was promoted from offensive analyst to wide receivers coach during the 2026 offseason.

injury_availability.fact: Tight end Kylan Fox suffered an injury at the start of training camp and is expected to miss the 2026 season.
Wide receivers De'Nylon Morrissette and Chauncey Magwood returned for 2026 after missing the 2025 season with injuries.
Tight end George Burhenn returned against Indiana State after 349 days without game action and caught two passes for 43 yards.
Magwood caught a six-yard touchdown against Indiana State after missing most of 2025 with an injury.

offensive_context.fact: Purdue's opening-game offense included 317 passing yards from Ryan Browne, 87 rushing yards from Fame Ijeboi and 107 receiving yards from Asaad Waseem.
All five Purdue players who scored touchdowns against Indiana State recorded their first points as Boilermakers: Tra'Mar Harris, Fame Ijeboi, Chauncey Magwood, Don Saunders and Asaad Waseem.

defensive_context.fact: Purdue recorded eight tackles for loss and three sacks in the season-opening victory.
Purdue allowed Indiana State 284 total yards and 12 first downs.
Purdue won the turnover battle against Indiana State with one takeaway and no turnovers lost.

special_teams.fact: True freshman kicker Jacobo Echeverria Lozano made all three field-goal attempts and all five extra-point attempts against Indiana State.
Echeverria Lozano's three field goals came from 39, 27 and 25 yards and were the most in a game by a Purdue freshman since at least 1995.
Buffalo transfer Dylan Drennan had one 54-yard punt with a 49-yard net in his Purdue debut.

series_context.fact: Purdue is 0-3-2 all-time against UCLA, and UCLA has won the last two meetings.
Purdue previously played UCLA twice in Southern California, tying 0-0 in 1959 and losing 31-21 in 1979; both games were at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum.
The 2026 matchup will be Purdue's third game at the Rose Bowl stadium, following a 14-13 win over USC in the 1967 Rose Bowl Game and a 34-24 loss to Washington in the 2001 Rose Bowl Game.

other_relevant.fact: Purdue entered the Wake Forest game 1-0 under second-year head coach Barry Odom.
Purdue added 32 transfers and 22 freshmen for the 2026 season, including 19 transfers from Power Four programs.
